text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Full year FY26 AUM growth likely to be 22%.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.",
      "outcome": "Core AUM growth was reported at 22% for FY26 in the Feb 2026 call reported metrics.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Feb 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Add 17 to 18 million customers in FY26.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "We now expect 17 to 18 million customers to be added to the franchise in FY '26.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Reported metrics for FY26 only show 3.93 million added in Q4 and 119.3 million total franchise.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Cost of funds between 7.55% to 7.60% by FY26 exit.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "We're likely to be between 7.55% to 7.60% in terms of cost of funds as we exit the year.",
      "outcome": "Cost of funds was 7.41% in Q4 FY26, outperforming the guided range.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 AUM growth between 20% to 24%.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.",
      "outcome": "Tracking well; AUM reached INR 5,84,624 crores by Sep 2026, up from INR 5,10,000 crores in Mar 2026.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Oct 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 ROE guidance of 19% to 20%.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.",
      "outcome": "Reported ROE was 20.4% in Q1 FY27 and 20.6% in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 and Oct 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Opex to NTI improvement of 25-40 bps in FY27.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.",
      "outcome": "Opex to NTI was 33.8% in Q4 FY26 and 33.4% in Q1 FY27, a 40 bps improvement.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "May 2026 and Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 credit costs between 145 to 160 bps.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "We expect this to continue to trend down... guiding for 145 to 160 bps next year, full year.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. While GNPA/NNPA are reported (0.96%/0.42% in Q2 FY27), the specific credit cost bps metric is not provided.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Oct 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Add 18 MM to 20 MM customers in FY27.",
      "made_in": "Oct 2026",
      "quote": "We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.",
      "outcome": "Tracking well; 5 million new customers added in Q1 FY27 alone.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call reported metrics"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 4,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management shows high credibility, consistently meeting or exceeding AUM growth, ROE, and cost of funds targets. They tend to be conservative with cost of funds guidance."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "AUM growth narrative of 22% matches the reported core growth exactly for FY26.",
    "Efficiency narrative (Opex to NTI) aligns with the 40 bps improvement seen between Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27.",
    "Profitability narrative (ROE 19-20%) is consistently supported by reported figures exceeding 20% in FY27.",
    "Cost of funds narrative was conservative; actuals (7.41%) were lower than the guided 7.55-7.60% floor."
  ]
}
